# Coupler.io Blog

> A comprehensive resource for data integration, visualization, and analytics covering dashboards, marketing reporting, and business intelligence tools.

Coupler.io Blog provides in-depth guides on creating dashboards, tracking marketing performance, and integrating data across platforms like Looker Studio, Power BI, and Google Sheets. The blog features curated collections of templates, competitive analysis of analytics tools, and tutorials for data export and automation.

## Key Topics

- Data Visualization
- Dashboard Templates
- Business Intelligence
- Data Integration
- Marketing Dashboards
- Looker Studio
- Power BI
- Multi-Channel Advertising
- Data Export
- Marketing Analytics
- Ecommerce Dashboards
- Google Sheets
- Data Automation
- Social Media Marketing
- Tableau

## Dashboard Collections & Templates

- [48 Marketing Dashboards To Track Your Progress](https://blog.coupler.io/marketing-dashboard): Collection of 40+ marketing dashboards for multi-channel ad tracking and KPI monitoring
- [Best Looker Studio Marketing Dashboards](https://blog.coupler.io/looker-studio-marketing-dashboards): Curated 30+ Looker Studio templates for marketing analytics and data visualization
- [38 Marketing Reporting Templates](https://blog.coupler.io/marketing-reporting-templates): 36 marketing reporting templates for campaign tracking across Google, Meta, LinkedIn Ads
- [Best 20 Ecommerce Dashboards 2026](https://blog.coupler.io/ecommerce-dashboards): Top ecommerce dashboards for Shopify with Looker Studio and Power BI integration

## Dashboard Creation & Design Guides

- [How to Create a Dashboard: All Methods in One Guide](https://blog.coupler.io/how-to-create-a-dashboard): Complete guide covering three approaches to dashboard creation with templates and tools
- [Data Visualization Dashboard: Benefits, Types, and Examples](https://blog.coupler.io/what-is-data-visualization-dashboard): Educational guide on data visualization dashboard creation and best practices
- [How to Track Employee Performance](https://blog.coupler.io/how-to-track-employee-performance): Comprehensive guide on employee performance tracking methods, tools, and best practices

## Data Integration & Export Tutorials

- [How to Export Data from Zoho Books on a Schedule](https://blog.coupler.io/how-to-export-data-from-zoho-books): Tutorial on automated Zoho Books data export to spreadsheets and BI tools

## Marketing & Analytics Strategy

- [Why LLMs Won't Replace BI Dashboards](https://blog.coupler.io/will-llms-replace-bi-dashboards): Analysis of LLMs vs BI dashboards and hybrid analytics approach for better decisions
- [How to Maximize TikTok Influencer Marketing](https://blog.coupler.io/tiktok-influencer-marketing-efforts): Tips for maximizing TikTok influencer marketing campaigns and partnership optimization

## Tools & Alternatives Comparison

- [6 Top Supermetrics Competitors and Alternatives in 2026](https://blog.coupler.io/supermetrics-alternative): Comparison of Supermetrics alternatives including Funnel.io, Adverity, and Fivetran
- [Windsor.ai Alternatives and Competitors 2026](https://blog.coupler.io/windsor-ai-alternatives-competitors): Competitive analysis of Windsor.ai alternatives for marketing attribution and data integration
